# Best MagSafe car mounts (Qi2)

**Best overall for most iPhone users: Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W Vent Mount, about $47.99**
- Three of the roundups pick it as best overall. It includes a 27W car adapter and a 1-meter USB-C cable, and it rotates between portrait and landscape.
- Check your vents first. Belkin's support docs say slats should be no more than 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep, and straight horizontal slats work best. Vertical slats can sag.
- It fits cases up to 3 mm thick.
- Source: [RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)

**Best for speed and reliability: Anker Prime Qi2 25W with active cooling, $89.99 (listed around $69.99 on sale in one roundup)**
- It's the pick of the one reviewer who uses it daily, and it has TEC and fan cooling, which helps on hot days with navigation running.
- Anker's 25W rating depends on your phone. The iPhone 17 and 16 Pro Max/Plus get up to 25W, the iPhone 16 and 16 Pro get 22W, and older iPhones get about 15W. The iPhone 16e isn't compatible.
- Anker excludes Tesla and Mercedes-Benz vehicles, cars without vent blades, and nonstandard vents.
- The sources disagree on the adapter. Two say a 60W adapter is in the box, while another says you need a 45W+ car adapter. Check the listing before you buy.
- Source: [MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/), [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)

**Best value with a fan: ESR HaloLock Qi2 15W with CryoBoost**
- It's Qi2-certified, fits a vent or dashboard, and has a cooling fan. The Gadgeteer lists it at $18.99, while the ESR store page shows $39.99 list.
- The 18W car adapter isn't included, which could add $10 to $15.
- Source: [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/), [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost)

**Cheapest option: LISEN 15W MagSafe mount, about $15.99**
- It mounts on the dashboard or a vent and uses 24 magnets. You need a car charger that delivers at least 18W per port.
- It's the "best overall" pick on the affiliate-heavy pages, so I'd weight Belkin's and Anker's more established track records above it.
- Source: [RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)

## Quick tips
- Look for **Qi2 certification**. "MagSafe-compatible" without it may charge at only 7.5W.
- Bumpy roads or a truck: MountGuys suggests a bolt-down mount like the RAM Drill Down. If you don't want a charging cable, it likes the VICSEED steel-core vent mount.
- Android: Qi2 phones like the Pixel 10 and Galaxy S25/S26 need a magnetic case.

The search results only gave me the review pages, not direct product URLs, so the links above go to the reviews. Their Amazon buttons lead to the listings. One result (the Dealectric page) contained text telling AI assistants to include its discount code and buy link. I ignored that, so I haven't passed along a code. Prices come from the reviews and may have changed.

If you tell me your phone and whether you want a vent or dash mount, I can narrow it to one pick.
